retrievalProfile.description: A complex circular emblem featuring multi-layered, ornate custom lettering with airbrushed gradients and metallic outlines against a stained-glass style background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular medallion containing a stained-glass pattern, overlaid with three distinct tiers of highly stylized, interlocking custom lettering. The top tier uses large, fluid script; the middle tier uses a curved banner; and the bottom tier integrates musical instrument motifs into the letterforms.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance around a vertical axis
coreInvariants: Airbrushed volumetric shading on all letters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The emblem is centered, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, fluid script at the top of the circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script, follow the curve down to the central banner, and rest on the bottom instrument-integrated text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background surrounding the central circular graphic.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows in the primary lettering.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep greens and blues in the circular background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and white highlights for sheen.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with smooth value transitions to simulate 3D volume.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-contrast between text and background circle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, high-contrast script and decorative serif
letterConstructionRules: Top tier: Interlocking, fluid script with thick-to-thin transitions.
Middle tier: Arched serif lettering following a ribbon path.
Bottom tier: Geometric construction integrated with trumpet and horn shapes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'P' in the top tier are oversized and serve as framing elements.
The bottom letters are formed by the brass tubing of musical instruments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Layered hierarchy using script, arched serif, and geometric-instrumental forms.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, interlocking nature of the top tier.
Matches the middle banner's structural feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a circular stained-glass motif with green and blue segments, centered on a white field, with a golden trumpet integrated at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three layers of custom lettering: a large orange-to-yellow gradient script at the top, a curved banner with serif text in the middle, and geometric text integrated into the trumpet at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering interlocking and fluid?
Does the color palette use airbrushed gradients?
Is the composition centered and circular?
Are musical instruments integrated into the design?

adjustableVariables: Degree of flourish in the script
mustRedesign: Specific character shapes that mimic protected logos
Exact artist names from the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color gradients in the text.
Ensure the circular background is centered.
Verify that the three tiers of text are distinct but cohesive.
Confirm the presence of metallic-style outlines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a circular stained-glass backdrop with three tiers of airbrushed, interlocking custom lettering, using warm-to-cool color contrast and metallic accents.
